# cut_tree_to_labels { #dyf.cut_tree_to_labels }

```python
cut_tree_to_labels(tree, max_depth, n_points, n_clusters)
```

Cut PCA tree at n_clusters and return point labels array.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                          | Default    |
|------------|--------|--------------------------------------|------------|
| tree       |        | PCA tree dict from build_pca_tree(). | _required_ |
| max_depth  |        | Depth used when building the tree.   | _required_ |
| n_points   |        | Total number of points.              | _required_ |
| n_clusters |        | Desired number of clusters.          | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                          |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | np.ndarray of shape (n_points,) with cluster labels. |
